$comment: Candidate type systems. Add a stack here and it appears in build/type.html. `have` lists the families the tester probes for — if you activate a family locally (Adobe Fonts, Monotype, a Fontstand trial), the tester detects it and renders it for real. Anything not present falls back and is marked missing.
